item.text: L’inventario conferma gli IPv6 richiesti e rotte preesistenti coerenti. Configuro cinque ruoli distinti su pc2/4/6/8/10, lasciando invariati router, indirizzi e routing.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'command -v named-checkconf || true; command -v named-checkzone || true
for d in pc2 pc4 pc6 pc8 pc10; do echo "### $d named.conf"; sed -n '"'1,160p' \""'$d/etc/bind/named.conf"; done
for f in pc2/etc/bind/db.root pc4/etc/bind/db.test pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test pc10/etc/bind/db.hints; do echo "### $f"; sed -n '"'1,200p' \""'$f"; done
printf '"'%s\\n' '### startup DNS lines'; rg -n 'named|resolv.conf' pc{2,4,6,8,10,12}.startup
printf '%s\\n' '### forbidden forwarders/default zones/hosts names'; rg -n 'forwarders|default-zones|www\\.test|portal\\.test|mail\\.services\\.test|status\\.services\\.test' --glob '"'!pc4/etc/bind/db.test'"' --glob '"'!pc8/etc/bind/db.services.test'"' . || true"

item.text:
Configurazione completata.

- Ruoli: pc2 root, pc4 primario `test.`, pc6 secondario via AXFR, pc8 autoritativo `services.test.`, pc10 resolver ricorsivo, pc12 client IPv6.
- Creati i file BIND in `pc2/4/6/8/10/etc/bind/`; deleghe, glue AAAA, record richiesti, hint esclusivamente verso pc2 e nessun forwarder.
- Cambiate solo le cinque direttive `image` DNS in `lab.conf` a `kathara/bind`.
- Aggiunti avvii `named` ai server e `nameserver 2001:db8:1100:4::10` a pc12.
- Verifica statica completata; non ho eseguito comandi Kathara/dig, come previsto dalla skill.
